name: Browse and filter catalogue on desktop
description: Verifies customers can combine catalogue filters and sorting and see the resulting products and accurate payment details.
steps: Open the public TechLipa360 storefront
Open Filters and select a brand and category
Enter a maximum deposit and maximum installment payment, then select payment frequency, RAM, storage, network and condition
Change sorting to Price: Low to High and then Newest first
Turn Available stock only off and confirm any unavailable item is marked out of stock
Open an in-stock device and review its cash price, deposit and installment details
expected: The result list updates to match selected filters, price and newest sorting work, stock status is clear, and in-stock product details show the saved payment terms.

name: Use catalogue filters on a mobile screen
description: Verifies the catalogue filter panel remains readable and usable on a phone-sized viewport.
steps: Open the storefront at a phone-sized viewport
Open Filters
Use the maximum deposit and payment fields and select a network
Clear all filters
Close and reopen Filters
expected: Filter fields fit the mobile screen without horizontal overflow, values can be changed, and Clear all filters restores the default results.

name: Staff sign-in and logout remain protected
description: Verifies catalogue changes do not break the existing authorized staff sign-in and logout workflow.
steps: Open the public storefront
Choose Staff sign in and enter an authorized staff email
Complete secure sign-in and confirm the staff dashboard is visible
Use the staff sign-out control
expected: Authorized staff can reach the protected dashboard and signing out returns to the public storefront.

name: Manage inventory and preserve pricing calculations
description: Verifies staff can manage a product and that the existing price, downpayment and duration calculations remain intact.
setup: Sign in as an authorized owner or manager and open Inventory
steps: Add a device with stock, cash price, downpayment and daily payment
Confirm the duration is calculated from the remaining balance and daily payment
Save the product and open its details
Edit product specifications and stock
Confirm its generated inventory serial and updated details remain visible
expected: The product is saved and editable, inventory serial generation remains automatic, and installment duration continues to be calculated from current price, deposit and daily payment.

name: Customer application continues to WhatsApp
description: Verifies the public application flow still saves customer details and opens WhatsApp with a prefilled application message.
steps: Open an in-stock device from the storefront
Choose Apply for this device
Enter customer name, phone, ID number and location
Choose Cash or Lipa Mdogo and review payment details
Submit the application
expected: The application is saved and WhatsApp opens with a prefilled message for the TechLipa360 business number, containing the selected device and application details.
